brief: The canvas depicts a retro, text-based terminal console simulating a cryptic computer program. The text is displayed against a dark background, emitting a subtle amber glow. A detective story unfolds in a monospace format, presenting system messages, narrative fragments, and clues. The user interacts by typing commands into an active input prompt at the bottom of the screen. Each command entered and executed by the user advances the mystery, revealing the next segment of the detective story and influencing the immediate text displayed in the console.

statement: This sketch creates a retro terminal interface that simulates a detective story unfolding through cryptic computer program messages. It features a dark background with amber text glowing subtly, displaying narrative fragments and system messages in a monospace font. The user interacts by clicking to enter commands at the bottom of the screen, which advance the mystery by revealing new segments of the detective story. The interface maintains a still appearance until user interaction triggers visual changes across the entire canvas.
